posts.title: Magic Knight Rayearth (2026) Episodes #06 – #08
posts.description: It appears that forging swords made from Escudo has taken its toll on Presea’s body. Oh please, I don’t want her to die just yet ’cause I wanna see Presea seeing the magic knights in triumph! Of course, Presea assured the magic knights that she’s fine. Still, I’m hoping that she’ll remain alive once Hikaru Shidou and her friends rescued Princess Emeraude from Zagato. Also, here’s both Fuu Hououji and Umi Ryuuzaki where they’re riding a strange vehicle together with Hikaru Shidou and Mokona. Speaking of Mokona, this little critter has no idea on where they should go first, much to Umi’s annoyance since she can’t understand what Mokona says. But you know what, the strange winged vehicle will guide their way to one of the temples scattered around Cefiro, including one specific temple located underwater. Anyways, time to awaken the Rune Gods! Starting with Ceres, the Rune God of Water who resembles a Western dragon. While Umi is linked to this particular Rune God, Ceres wants her to partak

posts.title: Magical Girl Raising Project: Restart Episode #07
posts.description: Well everyone, looks like Snow White is about to confront the game master as she has one simple demand… And that would be releasing all of the magical girls from the game, thus they’re free from being killed further. Sadly, the game master refused as expected ’cause she craves for violence. Also, here’s Fal where this little critter announced that six magical girls have died. Unfortunately for Fal, the game master is gonna delete this critter for not being malicious. But let’s go back to what’s important as the magical girls are fighting the Great Dragon. Of course, they could have retreated if it wasn’t for Melville telling everyone to continue fighting. Still, the situation is pretty dire when Clantail is in danger of being killed because she has the Dragon Slayer. Oh, and there’s a risk of being wiped out once Clantail is dead. posts.title: Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! Episodes #17 & #18
posts.description: Let’s begin with Sei Minamijuuji who’s having a serious conversation with Megrez, starting with his story where Sei’s father was a policeman until he quit the job because he accidentally arrested an innocent person and left to be executed. Despite his father succumbed to depression over his mistake, Sei is determined to know the whole truth of this world. And this brings them to discuss the next topic regarding the forbidden fruit, where it’ll gain lots of experience points when consumed and become stronger. While Lufas Maphaahl is capable of creating one by gathering mana, Megrez theorized that she was a descendant of the black-winged people who escaped the fury of the goddess and retained the ability to gather mana. Of course, Lufas is subjected to prejudice during her childhood and thus she vowed to change the world… until the Seven Heroes defeated her.
